response.justification: The candidate is a strong senior individual contributor with broad full-stack experience, deep open-source involvement, and solid Linux background, but he falls short on the core executive requirements. His German is self-reported as 'Basic' against a hard C1 minimum, he has no demonstrated experience leading or managing teams, and there is no evidence of formal architecture governance, UML modeling, requirements management, or client-facing consulting at the level this Head of Development role demands.
strengths: Extensive, diverse software development experience across web, mobile, embedded, and high-performance systems
Genuine open-source commitment (founder of GISCollective, multiple OSS libraries, FOSS4G talks) aligning with digital-sovereignty focus
Strong engineering craftsmanship: TDD, CI/CD, DevOps, Linux, and mentoring via workshops and courses
concerns: German at 'Basic' level, far below the required C1 minimum
No formal team leadership, people management, or executive-level experience — career is almost entirely senior IC roles
No evidence of UML expertise, requirements management, or IT security/compliance advisory experience

key_factors.factor: Strong open-source and Linux technical depth
